Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth for the Mutual Action Roadmap (attached). I pasted the milestone table below for quick reading; the attached RDW_MAP_draft_v1.2.xlsx contains owner-level detail and the procurement checklist.

Key goals we agreed on during the call:
- Target commercial signature & PO: customer procurement/finance sign-off (target) — please confirm the internal approval path and earliest realistic date.
- Integration kickoff and minimal data access for sandbox work.
- Production go-live target (tentative) aligned to procurement runway.

Proposed milestones (first draft) — please confirm or edit: 
1) Contract draft & SOW shared (Redwood legal) — by 2026-12-15 — owner: Jasmine Liu (Redwood Legal)
2) Procurement package sent to StellarSys procurement — by 2026-12-20 — owner: Marissa Cole
3) Internal procurement & budget approvals — target customer signature window 2027-01-18 to 2027-01-25 — owner: StellarSys Procurement
4) Integration sandbox access & data ingestion kickoff — target 2027-01-31 — owner: Jonas Weber
5) Production readiness & go-live prep — target 2027-02-14 — owners: Jonas / Ben Carter

Open items for you: 
- Can you confirm who will be the procurement approver(s) and the stakeholder we should list for the PO routing? (Name + email + role)
- Any internal legal review windows we should plan around (e.g., weekly legal review cadences)?
- Are there any calendar blackouts in Jan that would block signature?

Attachments included: RDW_MAP_draft_v1.2.xlsx (mutual-action roadmap, milestones, owners), procurement_checklist.pdf (short vendor packet).

If the timeline above looks reasonable I’ll lock the SOW review priority with Jasmine and ask Ben to prepare the technical readiness checklist. I’ll follow up with a concise one-pager for your procurement mailbox to speed routing.

Thanks — speak soon.

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the clear doc. A couple of notes from our side after internal sync with procurement and finance: 

1) Procurement path: our procurement manager (Mark Reed, cc'd) is the single point for vendor onboarding and will route to VP Finance and Legal. The earliest realistic signed PO date from our team is the week of Jan 24–28, 2027 due to our budgeting window and the VP calendar.

2) Legal review: our legal runs a weekly intake on Fridays. If we can get a clean SOW to Mark and legal by Dec 17, it should hit the Jan 21–28 decision window. If there are substantive redlines, expect an extra 7–10 business days.

3) Procurement asks: please include a short vendor packet (SOC2 snapshot + data handling summary + 1-page SOW highlights). That speeds our procurement intake.

I attached our internal procurement intake form (procurement_intake_stellarsys.pdf) — Mark, can you confirm if anything else is needed on our side?

If Jan 24–28 is the earliest your leadership can accept, we can aim for signature then. If Redwood needs to accelerate, flag so we can try to prioritize.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product Partnerships
